A null harvest was not printed: the crop ends on its simulated maturity or the day before the next sowing (protocol.chains.trial.crop_end).

notes: Every Doc prints one soybean sowing date per season, common to the treatments, so no soybean date is null and the Floresta missing-date rule is not needed.
Floresta: Doc 398 prints the corn and wheat dates as day and month under the calendar year of the row (2012 to 2015); the year is that of the row.
Londrina and Cafelandia: the predecessor row of season Y/Y+1 is sown in year Y (Doc 476 Tabela 3, Doc 459 Tabela 4).
